audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1] is titled 'Spell-shield his engage tool' but its body (dosFull[1].d) is the tradeGood sentence about Q/W-bounce trading, which has nothing to do with Spell Shield. dontsFull[2] is titled 'Chase kills off your tempo' but its body (dontsFull[2].d) is the tradeBad sentence about E spent on chip damage, not about chasing kills. Both are lint-flagged copy-paste bleed.
audit.why: Sivir's E (Spell Shield, 24/22.5/21/19.5/18s CD) blocks one targeted ability; Aphelios' Gravitum root and Calibrum mark are both single-target casts that can be shielded, but Severum's dash-and-attack is self-cast and untargeted so it cannot be blocked — that is the real content that belongs under 'Spell-shield his engage tool'. Separately, chasing a kill under Aphelios' tower costs the shove/tempo Sivir's whole game plan depends on — that belongs under 'Chase kills off your tempo'.
audit.corrected: dosFull[1].d -> shield-target guidance (Gravitum/Calibrum vs Severum); dontsFull[2].d -> chasing-kills-costs-tempo guidance

edits.before: Q the contact both ways, W-bounce the duo, walk — the trade taxed two people and refunded your mana bar.
edits.after: Save Spell Shield for Gravitum's root or a Calibrum mark — Severum is self-cast, so it won't block.

edits.before: Spending E on chip damage and eating the engage it existed to eat — the shield is the matchup; spend it like a verdict.
edits.after: A kill under his tower costs the wave and the timer — reset to your shove instead of walking into his teammates for one body.
